title: Ankhorage Game
summary: Provides platform-neutral config-driven game semantics and runtime primitives.
purpose: Give applications reusable game semantics without coupling their domain logic to a platform, rendering system, or hosting topology.
responsibilities: Expose reusable runtime primitives for game applications.
boundaries: Does not own a rendering engine or user interface.
Does not require a specific application, hosting provider, or deployment topology.
Does not provide deprecated compatibility paths.
audience: Application authors building config-driven game experiences.
Package consumers that need reusable game runtime primitives.
useCases: Build platform-neutral mini-game and gameplay semantics from configuration.

architecture.role: Reusable platform-neutral game semantics and runtime library.
invariants: The package remains standalone and consumer-agnostic.
Platform-specific behavior belongs outside the package core.

limitations: Rendering, hosting, and application-specific game policy are supplied by consumers.
